name: Developer
summary: Compilers, debuggers, code-security analysers and container tooling
description: A software-development and secure-coding toolkit: toolchains for C/C++, Python, Go and Rust, build systems and debuggers, static analysers and secret scanners, container and virtualization tools, and editors. Aimed at developers building and reviewing software securely on Shadow OS.
